newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Two Japanese die, 4 injured in Philippine accident.
newsitem.headline: Two Japanese die, 4 injured in Philippine accident.

text.p: Two Japanese died and four were seriously injured when their van plunged into a deep ravine in the northern Philippines, police said on Saturday.

Frederick Tsukushi, 42 and Minoru Akatani, 42, both from Sakasaki in Gunma prefecture west of Tokyo, died after Tsukushi lost control of the van on a windy road northeast of Manila on Thursday night, police said.
The wives of the two men, a one-year-old boy and a Japanese man travelling with the group suffered broken bones in the accident, police said.
